$comment: Machine-readable Sprint 2 plan. Prose rationale lives in specs/sprint-2-charter.md; this file is the shape delivery_loop_gate.py consumes. That script is NOT in this repo and must not be vendored here -- it ships with the pm-skills plugin, enabled at project scope in .claude/settings.json. Resolve it, do not hardcode: PM_SCRIPTS=$(find ~/.claude/plugins -path '*/pm-skills/scripts' -type d -print -quit) then python3 "$PM_SCRIPTS/delivery_loop_gate.py" --plan specs/sprint-2-loop-plan.json --mode plan --output human. See charter section 9. Every task carries acceptance.cmd rather than acceptance.criterion -- with a single human, owner == reviewer, and machine verification is what makes that non-circular (charter section 4).
goal: Make every doc claim about state match the system that owns it, and automate the sync check that catches the next drift. PLZG Sprint 2, board 169, sprint 44, 2026-07-30 to 2026-08-13.
